IX. CONSULTATION AND COORDINATION IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF THIS PROPOSAL AND PREPARATION OF THE DRAFT ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT
Copies of the original draft Environmental Statement were sent for
review and comment to the clearinghouses of all 50 States and Puerto Rico and
the Virgin Islands; to the Departments of Agriculture, Commerce, Transportation,
and Defense; to the National Park Service, U.S. Geological Survey, Bureau of
Land Management, Bureau of Reclamation, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, and
Assistant Secretary of Management and Budget in the Department of the Interior;
to the Environmental Protection Agency and to the private organizations,
Environmental Defense Fund, Inc., and to the Natural Resources Council of
America. As requested, a copy was sent to the U.S. Coast Guard, 9th Coast
Guard District, Cleveland, Ohio.
Replies were received, in most cases with comments, from 24 States representing all parts of the United States. Comments from a number of States included quoted or appended views of one or more State agencies and private organizations. The only Executive Department Comments came from Interior agencies. Response was received from the Environmental Defense Fund.
All comments received have been carefully reviewed and considered in revision of the draft Statement. We have responded herein to each comment and have either (1) acknowledged our agreement with the comment in total or in part and incorporated the suggestion into the draft or (2) indicated our disagreement with the comment and stated why.
This section is made up of the following contents:
